title: Cloud-Native & Cloud Architecture
intro: Cloud-native interview questions cover the cloud-vendor-agnostic patterns every modern backend interview probes — the 12-factor methodology, cloud design patterns (circuit breaker, bulkhead, retry-with-backoff, ambassador, sidecar), deployment strategies (rolling, blue/green, canary, progressive delivery), disaster recovery (RPO/RTO), multi-region active/active vs active/passive trade-offs, cost optimization (FinOps), and the orchestrator-choice question (Kubernetes vs ECS vs Cloud Run vs Lambda). Pair this with the AWS, GCP, Azure or Kubernetes pages for the platform-specific surface.
